tier: post-hoc measurement over retained per-epoch checkpoint grid; no training, no GPU launch, no code change

revision.reason: The executed run diverged from the v2 design in fork point, endpoint and the total absence of in-flight gating; v2 also assumed a single shared parent at step 22814, which the checkpoint lineage contradicts. v3 reframes the gates as post-hoc measurements and splits the parent into two explicitly labelled roles.

artifact_dirs.note: run live at freeze time; upper bounds grow until endpoint 22814

lever.unchanged: loss weights, sampling mechanism, learning rate 2e-4, batch_records 12, bandwidth, data pool

anchor_draw.upper_bound_rule: min(length - ic_frames - 100, per-record coda energy cap)

parents.rationale: The model the child actually diverged from, and the only comparison that is closest to function-preserving at step 0. G1 is a mechanism gate, so its 0.6x factor is only meaningful relative to this model.

Best existing model. G2 is an end-to-end quality bar, so the bar must be the best existing model rather than the model the child happens to have branched from. Any A4-vs-L1 delta is confounded by fork origin and may be reported for context only, clearly labelled.

lineage_confound.statement: The two arms fork from different checkpoints with different parent config digests and different increment lengths (18700 vs 19074). The shared endpoint 22814 is a coincidence of the step ceiling, not a matched budget. A4-vs-L1 deltas confound the anchor_fraction lever with a different fork origin.

function_preservation.note: The dense spectral kernels are radial re-parameterisations, absent from the anchor-unaware parent, so they cannot be inherited and are not zero. The child is therefore NOT bitwise identical to the fork parent at step 0, and v2's G3 (max abs diff <= 1e-6) does not hold and was never executed.

resume_overlap.overlap_rule: In 12904-13008 the resume directory is authoritative; the primary segment's records in that range are a discarded tail and must not enter any mean, trend or loss curve.
resume_overlap.checkpoint_ambiguity: none; <=12903 exists only in the primary segment, >=13090 only in the resume segment

measurement_lists.selection: M: f0-stratified 96/700 as in marmousi_gap_probe_20260912; N: f0-sorted stride sampling 32 per family

G1.metric: mean oracle re-anchor window relative L2 at anchor a = onset+200 over the M-list, 100 frames after the IC window
G1.reference_mean_note: filled by measuring the fork parent with the final measurement script BEFORE any child checkpoint is read
G1.kill_action_note: v2's TERM kill on G1 failure is void; the run is already in flight and no in-flight gating occurred

G2.metric: composed full-future train-marmousi mean relative L2 over the M-list
G2.bound_value_note: set by bound_setting_rule at parent-baseline freeze time, before any child measurement is read

bound_setting_rule.recompute_target: A4 step-22814 M-list marmousi mean, same script as child measurement
bound_setting_rule.expected_value_provenance: /root/autodl-tmp/staging/marmousi_gap_probe_20260912/train_records.jsonl, 96 records, mean 0.510744, min 0.229, max 0.7569; PROBE_META.json records checkpoint_sha256 ced7128a...804cd, global_step 22814, config_digest f4c44416..., manifest_digest 55fbffa9...
bound_setting_rule.if_within_tolerance_note: 0.46 is slightly looser than a strict 0.9 * 0.51074 = 0.4597; it is stated as the bound value, not a derived one
bound_setting_rule.if_outside_tolerance: re-freeze at 0.9 * recomputed_value before any child measurement is read
bound_setting_rule.outside_tolerance_interpretation: evidence about agreement between the old probe script and the new measurement script, NOT license to move the bound after seeing child numbers

cross_script_check.purpose: the recompute doubles as a cross-script consistency check on the A4 reference

N1_non_degradation.metric: full-future relative L2 at a = onset, one-shot

G2.recheck_policy: reported as a trajectory over the checkpoint grid; v2's epoch-20-then-epoch-60 kill schedule is void

G3.v2_definition: max absolute output difference <= 1e-6 on a fixed onset batch
G3.void_reason: the fresh dense spectral kernels are uniform-random, not zero, so the child is not bitwise identical to the fork parent at step 0; the check was never executed and is not replaced

reference_model_asymmetry.reason_G1: mechanism gate; the 0.6x factor is only meaningful relative to the model the child actually diverged from, which is also the closest thing to a function-preserving comparison at step 0
reference_model_asymmetry.reason_G2: end-to-end quality bar; the bar must be the best existing model, not the model the child happens to have branched from
reference_model_asymmetry.risk_if_collapsed: applying the 0.9x rule to the fork parent (step 3740, early training) would derive a much looser bound and could make G2 trivially passable, silently weakening the gate
reference_model_asymmetry.decision_owner: coordinator; recorded as a decision with reasoning, not to be re-litigated

sequence: 1. measure fork_parent (step 3740) M1 windows and context_reference (A4 22814) M-list/N-list N1 with the final measurement script
2. write per-record values, means and the script SHA256 into the frozen record
3. fix the G2 bound per bound_setting_rule at that moment
4. only then read any child checkpoint measurement
measurement_ordering.violation: reading any child value before steps 1-3 are frozen invalidates the gate judgement
measurement_ordering.measurement_script_sha256_note: filled when research/l1_gate_measure_20260913/measure_gates.py is final; authored concurrently by another agent, not by this preregistration
measurement_ordering.parent_baseline_values_note: filled at step 2 above; null here because no measurement has been run

trajectory_requirement.non_monotonicity: if the trajectory is non-monotonic, report the non-monotonicity itself; do not take the best point as the conclusion
